name: Phone Agent
notes: The README requires iOS 27, an ESP32-S3 board, AssistiveTouch, screen sharing, an image-capable model endpoint, and an API key. The app is built with Xcode, and the repository includes Swift app code and accessory firmware.
summary: An iPhone assistant that observes a shared screen and acts across apps using an ESP32-S3 Bluetooth mouse and keyboard accessory. The release includes app and firmware source.
